correctness.rationale: The calculation is correct. From T_Gr=S^* tensor Q and the tautological exact sequence, c1(T)=nH and K=-nH. For d=k(n-k), a general curve cut by d-1 Pluecker hyperplanes has degree D and adjunction gives 2g-2=(d-1-n)D. Sturmfels then gives Hdeg=2D+2g-2=(d+1-n)D=(k-1)(n-k-1)D. Kohn identifies this with delta_1 while delta_0=D. The Klein-quadric equality case follows immediately from the positive integer factor. The package finite grid is only regression evidence.

originality.rationale: Originality fails under the required implication standard. Sturmfels proves for every smooth projective variety of degree D and sectional genus g that the Hurwitz degree is 2D+2g-2. Kohn identifies coisotropic degrees with polar degrees and records delta_0=degree. For the ordinary Pluecker Grassmannian, the standard tangent-bundle identity immediately gives K=-nH, and one adjunction line on a general complete-intersection curve gives 2g-2=(k(n-k)-n-1)D. Substitution into Sturmfels is exactly the audited factor. Thus the final theorem is a routine specialization of a published general theorem using textbook Grassmannian geometry, even though the exact factor was not located verbatim.
